title: What Does "Delulu" Mean? Gen Z Slang Explained #shorts
description:
What does delulu mean? He's sure his charm can sell a Christmas tree to anyone.
• Delulu: believing something that is clearly not going to happen (Gen Z slang)
• Example: "Totally delulu" = that plan was never going to work

Ever been this delulu?
